unit_vocabulary.meaning: `det.` 他们的(形容词性物主代词)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Their parents are both doctors.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 他们 they 的所有格：“他们的” their。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron.` 他们(宾格)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I invited all of them to my party.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 他们 they 的宾格形式 them。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `det. & pron.` 这些
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: These apples are sweeter than those.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: this(这) 的复数形式 these(这些)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron.` 他们(主格)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They are playing football on the playground.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 第三人称复数“他们” they。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj. & pron.` 这；这个
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This is my new friend Tony.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 指示代词近指：“这个” this。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `det. & pron.` 那些
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Those birds fly to the south every autumn.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: that(那) 的复数形式 those(那些)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 老虎
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The fierce tiger has orange and black stripes.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 森林百兽之王：威猛的老虎 tiger。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron.` 我们(宾格)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Our teacher gave us some good advice.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 我们 we 的宾格形式 us。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 步行, 行走, 牵着(动物)走 `n.` 步行, 行走, 散步；人行道
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I walk to school with my sister every day.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 步行 walk，谈话 talk，粉笔 chalk。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 水, 水域, 水面 `v.` 灌溉, 给……浇水；流口水
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Drink clean water to keep your body healthy.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 生命之源：纯净的水 water。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron.` 我们
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We are proud of our school.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 第一人称复数主格“我们” we。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron. & det.` 什么, 多么；凡是……的事物, 无论什么
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What is your favourite subject at school?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 核心特殊疑问词：“什么” what。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` 到哪里, 在哪里, 在该处 `conj.` (在)……的地方
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Where is the post office, please?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 核心特殊疑问词：“在哪里” where。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 白色；白人, 白种人 `adj.` 白色的, 白的；白种人的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The snow on the mountain is pure white.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 洁白无瑕的白色 white。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron.` 谁, 什么人
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Who is the boy standing under the big tree?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 核心特殊疑问词：“谁” who。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (`pl.` women) 女人, 妇女, 女性, 妻子
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The kind woman helped the lost child find his way.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 成年女性 woman，复数不规则变为 women。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `int.` (狗叫声)汪汪
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The puppy barked with a lively woof.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 小狗欢快叫声的拟声词：汪汪 woof!

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `int.` 哇, 呀 `v.` 使喝彩, 使叫绝 `n.` 极大的成功
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Wow, this painting looks absolutely amazing!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 表示惊叹、赞美：Wow! 哇塞！

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 写, 写作, 写信, 编写, 写字
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Please write your name and class on the paper.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 写字 write，读书 read，听说读写必备。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 黄色的, 黄的, 黄皮肤的, 胆怯的 `n.` 黄色 `v.` (使)变黄
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The sunflower is bright yellow under the sunshine.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 向日葵般的金黄色 yellow。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 表示同意的答复 `int.` 哦, 对了；真的；一点不假；往下说
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Yes, I would love to join your study group.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 肯定回答“是” yes，对应否定回答 no。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron.` 你, 任何人, 你们
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You are welcome to visit our city anytime.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 第二人称“你、你们” you。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `det.` 你的, 您的, 你们的；大家的, 任何人的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Is this your new water bottle?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: you 的所有格：“你的、你们的” your。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 零；零度；最低程度 `v.` 将……调到零
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The temperature dropped to zero degrees at night.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 数字零 zero，英雄 hero。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 动物园
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Children love to see pandas and monkeys at the zoo.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 动物园 zoo，里面有 panda, monkey, tiger。
